purpose: Teach: 小笠原/手塚/工藤/テキサス/バスク/ヤクザ/弥生/ロッテ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、小笠原諸島の旅がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi—this customer loves traveling to the Ogasawara Islands, Mei said.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Sharing a small detail like turning over a smooth stone. Gentle wonder at what she's learned. Warm cadence, no rush.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、手塚治虫先生の漫画ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi—this customer's a huge Tezuka Osamu fan, Mei mentioned.
lines.style: Reflective pause before the revelation. Light interest lifting the middle of the sentence. Noticing something that matters to someone else. Conversational but unhurried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、工藤さんという作家のお知り合いだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi—this customer knows the writer Kudo, apparently. Mei told me.
lines.style: Slight lift of curiosity. Speaking as if turning a page—each detail deepening a picture. Genuine interest in how these pieces fit. Tender and present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、テキサスでの長期出張帰りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi—this customer just got back from a long assignment in Texas, Mei said.
lines.style: Recognition dawning. A thread connecting. Softer on the opening, settling tone as the detail lands. Unhurried breath between thoughts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、バスク料理のレストランを開きたいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi—this customer wants to open a Basque restaurant, Mei told me.
lines.style: Dreamlike quality. Speaking of someone's vision gently, like holding something precious. Slow, reverent pace. Noticing ambition without diminishing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、映画のヤクザもののファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi—this customer loves yakuza films, apparently. Mei found that out.
lines.style: Gentle amusement underneath. A small smile in the voice. Matter-of-fact but warm—observing without judgment. Conversational, almost conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、弥生時代の遺跡を巡るのがご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi—this customer enjoys touring Yayoi-period archaeological sites, Mei said.
lines.style: Drawn out softly. Savoring the specificity of it. A deep quiet interest. Unhurried, almost meditative. Like adding another layer to understanding someone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ロッテのプロ野球を応援されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi—this customer supports the Lotte baseball team, Mei mentioned.
lines.style: Gentle landing. A small detail that completes something. Warm acceptance. Trailing off with quiet satisfaction, like watching something settle into place.
